question: According to Union Budget 2025–26, approximately _______ was allocated for the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹3,413 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Budget 2025–26** has allocated approximately **₹3,413 crore** to the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** to bolster India's ecological and environmental initiatives.
 
• This allocation is pivotal for implementing the **National Mission for a Green India**, which aims at protecting, restoring, and enhancing India's diminishing forest cover and responding to **climate change**.
 
• A significant portion of this fund is dedicated to **Control of Pollution**, supporting the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)** to reduce particulate matter concentration in **131 cities** across the country.
 
• The budget also provides financial support to statutory and autonomous bodies under the ministry, such as the **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)** and the **National Green Tribunal (NGT)**.
 
• Funding for **Project Tiger** and **Project Elephant** is integrated into this allocation to ensure the conservation of India's **megafauna** and their natural habitats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC):**
 
 
• It is the nodal agency in the administrative structure of the **Central Government** for the planning, promotion, and coordination of India's environmental and forestry policies.
 
• The ministry was established in **1985** and is currently headed by the **Union Minister of Environment**.
 
• It oversees the implementation of major acts like the **Environment (Protection) Act, 1986** and the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**.
 
 
 
• **Budgetary Framework in India:**
 
 
• The **Union Budget** is the **Annual Financial Statement** of the country, presented under **Article 112** of the **Constitution of India**.
 
• The budget for **2025-26** was presented by the **Union Finance Minister**, **Nirmala Sitharaman**, on **February 1, 2025**.
 
• Budgetary allocations reflect the government's priorities, such as the **Net Zero by 2070** commitment made at **COP26**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Climate Action and Mission LiFE:** The budget supports **Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment)**, a global movement aimed at individual and community action to protect the environment.
 
• **Coastal Management:** Funds are also earmarked for the **Integrated Coastal Zone Management** project to conserve marine biodiversity and improve the livelihoods of **coastal communities**.
 
• **Circular Economy:** There is an increased focus on **waste management** and **circular economy** principles to ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
 
• **Ramsar Sites:** The allocation assists in the maintenance of **Wetlands of International Importance**, helping India fulfill its obligations under the **Ramsar Convention**.

77:T
